title: compiled/oneshots.json: how each one-shot container kind runs (A13)
description: Frozen in phase 001. Emitted by k2gen.emit.pipeline (S16), read by the operator that starts one-shots (phase 002) and checked against compose by S22. Names only: an env entry is a variable's name, a secret entry a read-only path from k2gen.model.SECRET_FILES; no value is ever in a release.

fetch.description: Egress only: never on k2-catalog, no storage key, no secret file (A8).

cpus.description: The CPU limit, as compose spells it.

memory.description: The memory limit, as compose spells it.

env.description: The only environment variables passed to it, by name.

secrets.description: The read-only container paths of the secret files it mounts (k2gen.model.SECRET_FILES, k2gen.model.password_mount).
